* Clocking

** STARTED Rewrite the parser                                             :work:
   SCHEDULED: <2026-08-20 Thu>
   :LOGBOOK:
   CLOCK: [2026-08-20 Thu 09:15]
   :END:
   An open CLOCK line alone does not set `org-clock-hd-marker'.  A test must
   clock in on this entry, or call `org-resolve-clocks', before asserting the
   predicate that compares the row marker with `org-clock-hd-marker'.
